claims.claim: Ants live together in colonies, which are eusocial, communal, and efficiently organized.
claims.evidence: Ant colonies are described as eusocial, communal, and efficiently organized
claims.quote: Ant colonies are eusocial, communal, and efficiently organized

claims.claim: A typical colony consists of one or more egg-laying queens, numerous sterile females, and seasonally, many winged sexual males and females.
claims.evidence: The typical colony consists of one or more egg-laying queens, numerous sterile females (workers, soldiers) and, seasonally, many winged sexual males and females
claims.quote: The typical colony consists of one or more egg-laying queens, numerous sterile females (workers, soldiers) and, seasonally, many winged sexual males and females

claims.claim: Ants undertake flights to establish new colonies, with swarms of winged sexuals departing the nest in search of other nests.
claims.evidence: In order to establish new colonies, ants undertake flights that occur at species-characteristic times of the day
claims.quote: In order to establish new colonies, ants undertake flights that occur at species-characteristic times of the day

claims.claim: The males die shortly thereafter, while a small percentage of females survive to initiate new nests.
claims.evidence: The males die shortly thereafter, along with most of the females. A small percentage of the females survive to initiate new nests
claims.quote: The males die shortly thereafter, along with most of the females. A small percentage of the females survive to initiate new nests

claims.claim: Ants have colonized almost every landmass on Earth.
claims.evidence: Ants have colonised almost every landmass on Earth
claims.quote: Ants have colonised almost every landmass on Earth
